patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Demandbase and Gong share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Demandbase only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-marke” rather than Gong's shape. Choose Gong only if your buying job matches “Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal” rather than Demandbase's shape. Workflow advantage: Demandbase leans prospecting, data-enrichment; Gong leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Demandbase and Gong share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Demandbase is Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-market orchestration — custom-quote packaging.; Gong is Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal only (no public dollar list)..
- Workflow coverage skew: Demandbase-leaning prospecting, data-enrichment vs Gong-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Demandbase — Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Gong — Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases.

Limitations — Demandbase: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Enterprise ABM scope means substantial implementation and change-management cost; Gong: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Not a prospecting/enrichment data core.

Poor-fit cases: Demandbase is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices · Gong is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases · Avoid Demandbase if you actually need Gong's motion (Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custo)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
